Today we are updating our guidance for 2026: • With a portion of this year’s revenue moving into the first part of next year, we now expect 2026 revenue at the low end of our $3.0-3.4 billion range, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of ca. 40%. • We now expect the ARR we guided to for December to arrive in February, even before New Jersey ramps up to full capacity. And we are also sharing our initial outlook for 2027: • We expect to reach pre-tax breakeven by the end of 2027, on the back of the structural benefits discussed above. • We expect revenue of $12-13 billion, reflecting a conservative approach to the pace of our build-out. We continue to expect to bring online more than 1 GW of new capacity each year. • We anticipate capex of $40-45 billion, with a disciplined and diversified funding mix. • As the business matures, we are moving to metrics that better reflect its underlying performance.
